# DAX time intelligence functions in Lumen

> **Applies to:** Analysts · Developers

Support status, in Lumen's DAX engine, of every function that Microsoft's DAX reference lists under **Time intelligence functions**: 33 implemented, 0 partial and 8 not implemented, out of 41.

Classic (date-column based) time intelligence is implemented. The week-based functions (DATESWTD, TOTALWTD, STARTOFWEEK, …) work only with Power BI's calendar-based time intelligence, which Lumen does not implement. See [Time intelligence](../../dax/time-intelligence.md).
